label: unrewarded-trial a1/S1 signal (D1 after no reward, D2 on a1->S1) late in episode
explanation: Fires only at D1 and D2, never at GO, and only on trials after an UNREWARDED one (in_rew = 0 at D1; prev_reward = 0 carried into D2). At D1 the previous choice was a1 (or the window starts there); at D2 the choice was a1 and the state reached was S1 (common). It never fires after a2 or S2 input or after a reward. The gate (no reward, a1/S1) is a necessary condition with about 99.9% mass recall but only 10% precision. Two more observed conditions raise precision: the policy logit leans toward a1 (choice in about 2.8 to 8; it never fires on strong a2 or very strong a1 preference), and the episode is late (trials 40-89; zero activity before trial 30 and almost none after 90). All variables are observed or are the output of the model itself; no future variables. Precision stays around 0.27, so most qualifying steps stay below threshold. Magnitude is not modeled: the largest activations are at D1 after an unrewarded a1 trial, and D2 activations are about half that size.
